title: o-mcp/nodelist version 1
description: Nodes in effect on query.as_of that match every filter in query, ordered by code. Returned by plant_find. A list, not a subgraph: for how the nodes connect, ask plant_section. Unknown fields may appear in later version-1 documents; ignore them.

schema.description: Names the format. Check it, and version, before reading anything else.

version.description: Format version. Adding fields keeps it at 1; removing, renaming or changing the meaning of a field makes 2.

query.description: What was asked for. Filters that were not given are absent.

as_of.description: The day the plant is described as of, YYYY-MM-DD, site time.

text.description: Part of a code or name, matched ignoring case.

type.description: Node type; its subtypes matched too.

utility.description: Only nodes with an edge of this utility.

metered.description: Whether a meter is on the node or its feeder.

site_status.description: Declared status; none means nothing declared.

total.description: How many nodes match. Above returned means the list was cut at limit.

returned.description: How many nodes are in nodes.

id.description: The node's graph.node.id, which stays when its code changes (design/frontend.md §5). The frontend stores it.

code.description: The node's code; other tools take it.

name.description: Human-readable name, as the site calls it.

type.description: Node type; null if not yet typed.

utilities.description: Utilities of the live edges at this node.

metered.description: True when a meter is on the node itself or on an edge into it. False: its values are inferred by the solver from its neighbours.

feeders.description: Live edges into the node that carry flow. More than one on a board or load is an open question for the site, unless one is a PV plant or generator.

site_status.description: Status the site declared (normal or inactive); null when nothing is declared, which is not the same as normal.

site_status_as_of.description: The day the status was declared, YYYY-MM-DD.
